title: Unit Event — Happy Enjoy Music!

meta.Outline: With their new song released, Leo/need looks forward to Jam Fest. Saki, nervous before her first festival, encounters a familiar face...

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Saki & Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Leeet's eat!
Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm! The scrambled eggs have a different texture to them today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, they seem fluffier for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Oh, you noticed?
I tried mixing in a little mayonnaise today. That apparently helps make them a bit fluffier.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So that's what it is!
These are great! They're so fluffy and full of flavor♪

rows.Speaker: Commercial
rows.Line: <This Moment With You!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Commercial
rows.Line: <Lemonade-flavored FizzYum Cider is only available for a limited time! Let's go out there and enjoy our youth together!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, Saki, it's your band's song!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I don't think I'm ever going to get tired of this one.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
We have to thank Ichi for putting so much effort into it!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It really is a beautiful expression of youth, isn't it?!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, it is. Also...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: I couldn't be happier about your band's song being used for this commercial. You've been watching this company's ads since you were little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mom...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, this is indeed a momentous occasion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You're back in school, just like in this commercial, having fun and enjoying your youth....
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-Stop it, Tsukasa! Don't cry!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, hearing our song on TV really does make it feel like we're pros now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We need to do our best at Jam Fest, too!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Saki, do you have practice today?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, that's right! Today we're meeting with our company, then having practice until the evening.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I probably won't be home until really late, so go ahead and have dinner without me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, good luck!
We'll be cheering you on, Saki!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, look at the time!
I'm gonna be late if I don't go now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Saki! You'll choke if you scarf down your food like that! You should take smaller bites and chew carefully!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Thanks for breakfast!
Gotta go!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: Okay, stay safe.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
...is what happened!
My mom and Tsukasa got all teary-eyed on me earlier this morning!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. They never change.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's the same over at my house. Every time that commercial comes on, Shizuku locks right onto my face...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: My dad also keeps shouting, “It's Ichika's song!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They really can't contain their excitement.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, but I suppose that's only natural for your families to feel that way. They've been supporting you all this time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're likely happier than anyone to see you girls going pro together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, that means we gotta make the most of their support by doing well at Jam Fest.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Agreed. Especially since it's going to be our first show since going pro. I'm sure that many of our most loyal fans will be there as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I definitely want to put on a good show for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: While we're on the subject, what's Jam Fest actually supposed to be like? We know that it's one of those events where lots of different bands perform...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... Jam Fest is similar to most other music festivals. There's going to be several big stages where bands will be performing simultaneously.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: This event will have three stages.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The most famous bands will be performing on the main stage, up-and-coming bands on the sub stage...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And the one we'll be playing at is the rookie stage, which is for bands that have just debuted.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The guests are free to move between those three stages and see whichever bands they like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, having so many stages to choose from sounds like a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It sounds like people from all walks of life will be attending...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yes, that's usually the case.
But most will be there to watch the main stage, so I'm not sure how many will be interested in seeing us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: However, I did hear that STANDOUT and anemone will also be performing on the rookie stage.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So we'll need to put on a good performance. Can't let them show us up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. Which means we need to get in a good practice today!

rows.Speaker: Ichika, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah!
Two hours later

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whew, I'm exhausted!
Can we take a break now?!
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, but when we start back up, we're going right back to the part of the chorus you just messed up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Urgh...! O-Okay...
*Sigh*
Learning to play a new song is always so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Why don't we make some of the tea Honami brought over? We still have some left.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I'll help with that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
It'll be ready in no time if all three of us work together!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. Then, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Still, your new song really is lovely.
What did you call it? “Blue Moments”...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Every time I hear it, you immediately pop into my mind, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That means it was worth working on it until the very last minute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I feel really bad about making Mr. Shindo wait for me like that. I knew what I wanted to do, but I just couldn't seem to find the right sounds for it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I still have a lot to learn...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
But I agree with Miku.
I think this song turned out beautifully.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I know it must've been a struggle, but I think it's a nice expression of your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really? Thank goodness...!
I'm so glad that you're all saying this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Especially since it's a song about our youth♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Speaking of youth...
Wasn't that the theme of the music video you all shot the other day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
We shot it at a school, and the story behind it was so good!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It actually just got uploaded too, so have a look!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? No, Saki, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing what it's like.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We even got to do some acting this time around!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We worked really hard on it, so get ready to have your minds blown!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Then, does that mean we get to see a different side of you girls?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, let me see.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I wanna watch it too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then, let's watch it together!
Come squeeze in, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: P-Please, Saki...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for waiting, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? What are you guys doing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, you're back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were just about to watch our new music video!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, your new music video?!
I wanna watch!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Aah...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something wrong, Ichika? You're acting a little funny.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Haha...
I'm guessing she's a little embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Since she was basically the protagonist of this video's story.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yes... I told them that I probably wasn't the right person for the job, but they kept saying how things turn out better when the vocalist is in the spotlight...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what's the story about?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Umm... It starts with me sitting in a classroom feeling bored. Then, Saki invites me to form a band...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We go out into the corridor, run into Honami and Shiho, and invite them to join us. We go up to the rooftop to play together...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, based on what you've told us so far, it seems like a story that suits your band well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What he said! There's no reason to be embarrassed!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, you guys! I'm gonna play it now!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, it's showtime!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, Ichi, is this you?!
You look really cool!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's because she is!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Honestly, you seem like a totally different person. Maybe it's your expression?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The director asked me to do a bit of face acting for this scene to give it a bigger impact...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seem really grown-up for some reason.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe! I'm really enjoying this!
It's like we're getting to see a brand-new side of Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Th-Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But this is still really embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I mean, Saki, you kept grinning and looking my way while we shot this scene.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? I did?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, you did the same thing to me.
Do you know how hard it was for me to keep a straight face?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You too, Shiho?!
I was just trying to diffuse the tension a little!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I guess it did help a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. This shoot was much more involved than our last one. It posed a few challenges, but we thankfully were able to get through it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Setting our acting aside, the video did turn out pretty well in the end.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, for the VIRTUAL SINGER music video, they got this illustrator I really like to do all the artwork. That made me so happy...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Their artwork was so gorgeous!
I was actually sorta stunned by how our song could be depicted in such an amazing way!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
That's great.
So, how has it been received?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Pretty well... Actually, better than expected.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes...! It currently has around five million views. At this rate, it might spike even more.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
What?! Five million?!
That's amazing...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's unbelievable! I felt the same way with our last song, but I honestly never expected it to do this well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This means we gotta start practicing giving autographs!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're getting way ahead of yourself now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It is astonishing how many views its been getting, but it's also evidence of just that many people listening to our music. Which is wonderful news.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Some people might come see us at Jam Fest after listening to this song. So, we need to practice as much as we can for them.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right! We gotta put on an amazing performance for them!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, let's resume practice after we finish our tea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay♪ I'm gonna look really cool while I play, just like we do in the music video!
A few days later
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
Let's keep up this momentum as we prepare for the festival.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay! Get home safe, you guys!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Today's practice was really tough, but also really fun!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait for Jam Fest...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's the biggest venue we've ever played at, so I hope a ton of people come to see us there.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Plus, it's gonna be our first show since going pro, so we gotta do a good job...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Still, I can't help but feel a little nervous, since this is also gonna be our first big festival...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's probably gonna feel different from the joint and solo shows we've done until now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Is it really okay for us to prepare for it just by practicing like we always do?)
Okay, see you tomorrow.
Alright, bye!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? That sounded like...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Iori?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Wait, you're...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sorry for calling out your name all of a sudden! I'm Saki Tenma from Leo/need!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, I don't know if you remember me, but you've helped us quite a lot and...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're that keyboardist.
The girl who's always having so much fun while she plays.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, you remember who I am?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Also, do I really play like that?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, Leo/need always looks like it's having fun, but I feel like you usually have the most fun.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: And I get to have fun watching.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Leo/need's playing at Jam Fest, right? I'm looking forward to seeing you all there.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, likewise!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Iori, while we're on the subject, can I ask you a quick question?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hm? Sure.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... What's it like to play at a big music festival?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is gonna be our first one...
So, if possible, can you tell me more about them?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
Alright, so...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: For starters, depending on the size of the festival, you'll be dealing with a lot more people than normal. Tens of thousands even.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Th-That many?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: However, not everyone in attendance will be there to see us.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Loads of them will be people who have never heard of us, who are here for other bands.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: There's a chance folks like that, who don't have any interest in us, might leave when we take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Especially if there's a famous band also playing during your timeslot, you might not get any people watching at all. That happens.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: That's why you have to put on a performance that'll grab people, and make them think twice before leaving.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Easier said than done.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Right... Shiho even said that a lot of people are gonna be focused on the main stage.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But getting people to stop and listen after they've already written you off...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Drawing them in with your music when that's what you're up against? It's the best feeling in the world.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (That's what I felt when we played with anemone...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's impossibly hard to convince people who aren't interested to stay.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (When you see your song getting through to them... It really is the best feeling in the world...!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um, Iori!
Can you tell me about how we should prepare?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I want us to succeed no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is going to be Leo/need's first show since going pro, so I wanna reach as many people as we can with our songs!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Then, since we're here, why don't we grab a quick bite together?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What? A-As in a meal?!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm sure you worked up an appetite during practice.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Plus, you released a new song recently.
I'd like to hear more about it, so it'll be my treat.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, you don't have to...!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: It's fine. You want to hear what I have to say, right? So, let's go.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Uhh... R-Right!
Thank you very much!
Jam Fest
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Alright, we're all here.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: I hope you all got plenty of sleep last night.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We did! Hona gave us lots of stern reminders to rest up before our big day!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: D-Did I give that many reminders...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I do feel that we were able to rest up properly because of you, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
After all, I need you all to play with everything you have today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: O-Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line:
I'm joking.
You should be just fine as long as you play the way you always do.

rows.Speaker: Shindo
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to go greet the staff, sponsors and everyone else involved. Please feel free to relax until it's time to rehearse.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
Since we have time, why don't we go greet the other bands?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
Especially since STANDOUT and anemone are also here.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We'll be playing on the same stage, so I'd like to say hi to them as well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, that settles that!
So, let's go!
STANDOUT Green Room

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Pardon us!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hello! We're here to pay our respects!

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Huh? Tenma?
Wait, respects?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Umm... We're Leo/need.
We look forward to playing alongside all of you today.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
Oh, welcome.
You all came together. huh?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line: Hello. Let's all do our best today!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes, our absolute best!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Can you tell us which songs you're going to play today, Iori?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, today...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Were Saki and Iori always this close?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No idea...
Hello. Oh, Leo/need's also here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saku...!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
This is perfect.
Our plan was to greet you next.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: Anyway, STANDOUT, Leo/need, let's all do our best today!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh...
Yes, let's all do our best!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, didn't Leo/need release a new song recently?

rows.Speaker: Mio
rows.Line:
Oh, the one for that cider commercial.
We were actually just talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, we really liked it.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: You spent a lot of time working on it, right, Ichika? Tenma told me everything.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki did...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. We had a chance to talk about a bunch of stuff the other day♪

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
And she told me a lot.
Including what happened while you wrote that song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sh-She did?
Now I'm starting to feel embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: There's no need to feel embarrassed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Because I also like that song.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You do...?!

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
But it's not something I'd listen to normally.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member A
rows.Line: You didn't have to say that last part!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Still, thank you.
We really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to hear that you two had already listened to it.

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I mean, you hear it just walking around Shibuya, whether you want to or not.

rows.Speaker: anemone Member B
rows.Line: Saku, phrasing!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-Haha...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we really do appreciate it. The truth is, we weren't sure we should even make it...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: Huh, really?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Saku
rows.Line: I see. You were originally given this offer because the VIRTUAL SINGER version of your other song went so viral, and they wanted it again.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: To be fair, it's a fairly common occurrence. We actually went through something similar.

rows.Speaker: STANDOUT Member A
rows.Line: Haha. Remember how much we argued with them that time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, you argued back?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Yeah, we were told to write a song based on this melody that everyone else had been using at the time.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But I felt that doing so would effectively spell the end of STANDOUT's music. So we said no.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Your band also said no to producing VIRTUAL SINGER versions of all the songs you wrote moving forward like your company wanted, right, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, we did...
But unlike STANDOUT's situation, that was just me being selfish...

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line:
What's wrong with being selfish?
I actually think you made the right call.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Sure, being professional musicians means having to do what you can to be marketable.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: Our company's also begun making more demands, which has resulted in us having a little less freedom.

rows.Speaker: Iori
rows.Line: But you can't just say yes to everything. I think it's important to draw a line somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Honami
